title: Very thin! But pretty.
text: Very thin! But pretty.. [[VIDEOID:a4e019f6fbec82f12c309d1ec1ef2f05]] I love the look/color/pattern of this rug. But I was pretty surprised by how thin it is. It feels like a towel. It’s basically tightly woven baker’s twine. The hem is threadbare in a few spots. The backing is soft cotton (no rubber or polypropylene) Because of it’s weight, it doesn’t quite lay flat. You can see evident folds. It also means it slides around a bit. I don’t have a pad under it, but I bet that would solve a few of the issues I’ve listed above. If you need a huge rug for a low price, this is an an excellent choice. But doesn’t expect plush, heavy longevity.
